name: Brother Neals
summary: Brother Neals is a monk residing in Northshire Abbey within Elwynn Forest. Responsible for managing the abbey's stores of food and drink, he spends much of his time overseeing shipments and sampling the vintage produced by the local vineyard.

sections.title: Keeper of the Cellar
sections.body: Tucked away in the upper belfry rooms of Northshire Abbey, Brother Neals looks after the monastery's culinary provisions and beverage stores. He takes a particular, enthusiastic interest in the Northshire vineyards, carefully tracking grape manifests and ensuring the quality of the abbey's renowned wine by tasting it with dedicated frequency. Despite the peaceful duties of inventory and cellar management, he keeps close tabs on the shipments arriving from the valley's surrounding fields.

faq.answer: Brother Neals is a member of the brotherhood at Northshire Abbey who manages food, drink, and wine inventories for the clergy and recruits stationed in the valley.

faq.q: Where can Brother Neals be found?
faq.answer: He stays in the uppermost room of Northshire Abbey. To reach him, head up the stone staircases inside the main hall until you reach the quiet chamber near the top of the tower.

faq.q: What is his role regarding the vineyard?
faq.answer: He tracks the grape harvests and wine shipments coming in from the nearby Northshire Vineyard, though he is known to spend just as much time sampling the vintage as he does balancing the ledgers.

angles.text: Brother Neals manages the monastery's provisions and spirits, making him a kindred spirit to anyone interested in the culinary arts and brewing traditions of the kingdom.
